description: This PHP class manages batch migration processes within Drupal's migrate_drupal_ui module, including handling migration execution, event listeners, follow-up migrations, and logging.

classes.name: MigrateUpgradeImportBatch
classes.description: Handles batch migration processes, including execution, event handling, follow-up migrations, and logging within Drupal's migrate_drupal_ui module.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes a batch of migration IDs, manages event listeners, processes migration results, and updates the batch context.

methods.name: finished
methods.description: Callback for when the batch process completes; logs success or failure messages.

methods.name: onPostRowSave
methods.description: Interrupts the migration batch if execution time exceeds the maximum allowed.

methods.name: onPostImport
methods.description: Adds follow-up migrations after a migration completes successfully.

methods.name: onPostRowDelete
methods.description: Interrupts the batch if execution time exceeds the maximum allowed during row deletion.

methods.name: onMapSave
methods.description: Increments processed count on map save event.

methods.name: onMapDelete
methods.description: Increments processed count on map delete event.

methods.name: onIdMapMessage
methods.description: Displays messages logged to the ID map, categorizing as status or error.
